map.逾期付款利息计算器 使用指南: Overdue Payment Interest Calculator User Guide
map.输入欠款本金、起算日期与适用利率标准，按同期 LPR 计算逾期付款违约金或迟延履: Enter the overdue principal, the start date and the applicable rate standard, and compute overdue payment penalty or doubled debt interest for the delayed performance period at the prevailing LPR, helping creditors quantify overdue losses.
map.债务人逾期付款，按 LPR 一至四倍或加倍债务利息估算逾期利息。: When a debtor pays late, estimate overdue interest at one to four times LPR or as doubled debt interest.
map.民间借贷逾期利率同样受 LPR 四倍上限约束。: Overdue interest rates on private lending are likewise capped at four times LPR.
map.计算日利息与总利息，辅助主张或和解。: Compute daily and total interest to support a claim or settlement.
map.：设 LPR 3.45%，1.5 倍 = 5.175%；日利率 = 5.175%: : take LPR 3.45%, 1.5 times = 5.175%; daily rate = 5.175% ÷ 365 ≈ 0.014178%; daily interest = 500000 × 0.014178% ≈ 70.89 CNY; 100 days totals about 7089 CNY.
: at 1.75 per ten thousand per day (0.0175%): 500,000 × 0.0175% = 87.5 CNY/day, 100 days = 8750 CNY (common for the doubled portion of an unperformed monetary obligation).
map.LPR 倍数怎么选？: How is the LPR multiple chosen?
map.有约定从约定但不得超 LPR 四倍；无约定可参照 LPR 或主张资金占用损失，具: Follow the agreement if there is one, but it may not exceed four times LPR; with no agreement, refer to LPR or claim loss of use of funds, with the specific standard depending on the contract and judicial interpretation.
map.加倍债务利息和普通利息能叠加吗？: Can doubled debt interest and ordinary interest be stacked?
map.生效文书指定的给付义务，未按期履行的按日万分之 1.75 计加倍部分；与文书本身: For payment obligations specified in an effective document that are not performed on time, the doubled portion is charged at 1.75 per ten thousand per day; it can coexist with the interest set in the document itself, but the total is bounded by statutory caps and the document.
